brief_summary: Hero art for the guides-pillar article on evaluating a group buy before paying. Adapts bearings.md's guide default (annotated keycap row) per the article's own frontmatter heroImageAlt, which specifies a timeline motif instead: a left-to-right timeline arrow through four checkpoints (announced, live, closed, shipped) with a branch peeling off after 'closed' toward a dimmer, dashed 'delayed' checkpoint, and an ochre splash marking the branch point.
source: apps/web/src/content/articles/how-to-evaluate-a-group-buy.mdx frontmatter heroImageAlt; plan/bearings.md § Article hero art — colorful keyboard SVGs (locked 2026-05-09)
template: directive: simple line drawing + single splash of color illustrative of subject; guide default is an annotated keycap row, reinterpreted here per the article's own heroImageAlt as an annotated timeline since that is the article's literal subject (evaluating a listing's lifecycle before paying)
subject: A horizontal timeline arrow running left to right through four open circular checkpoints labeled ANNOUNCED, LIVE, CLOSED, SHIPPED (JetBrains Mono, uppercase, confident). Just past the CLOSED checkpoint — the point where funding is done but production is not — a dashed branch peels downward toward a dimmer, dashed DELAYED checkpoint labeled in a hushed italic Newsreader lowercase rather than the confident mono of the main line. An ochre focal dot marks the branch point itself, with a soft ochre wash behind the whole delayed region. A few fading dashes trail off past the delayed checkpoint with no arrowhead, standing in for the open-ended wait described in the article's lede rather than a resolved outcome. Bronze theme dot at the upper-right margin.
alt: A hand-drawn timeline arrow running left to right through four labeled checkpoints — announced, live, closed, shipped — with a branch peeling off toward a dimmer, dashed delayed checkpoint, rendered in warm-grey line work with an ochre splash marking the branch point.
